subject.title: Doubao: query Coding/Agent Plan usage via arkcli CLI

question: Should Doubao auto mode prefer `arkcli` SSO while preserving separate explicit CLI and API-key strategies, and should the existing AK/SK credential surface be removed now or retained for compatibility?
rationale: The PR changes the provider’s authentication and source-selection contract, and source ordering plus credential deprecation require maintainer intent beyond a mechanical correction.

options.title: Separate CLI and API strategies
options.body: Add a real `.cli` strategy first in auto mode, keep the existing `.apiToken` fallback, and remove AK/SK only with consistent settings and documentation.

options.title: Replace API behavior with CLI
options.body: Make `arkcli` the sole plan-usage source and explicitly deprecate or remove all AK/SK and API-source expectations with upgrade notes.

options.title: Keep current API model
options.body: Do not land the CLI path until the existing signed/API approach and credential UX are resolved separately.

recommendation.title: Separate CLI and API strategies
recommendation.body: Add a real `.cli` strategy first in auto mode, keep the existing `.apiToken` fallback, and remove AK/SK only with consistent settings and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes provider-wide source semantics, settings compatibility, and user setup policy.
